verdict.rationale: Sentry's own Seer debugging agent is marketed as fixing issues in the background ('while you ship what's next') by generating merge-ready patches, which hints at autonomous background work. The evidence is only a homepage line, though: nothing shows users configuring, triggering or scheduling their own automations. The agent-tracing and dashboard docs cover observability, not automation. Missing for 10: documentation of user-configurable automations, trigger and schedule setup, evidence that Seer runs autonomously without manual invocation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
